spans.s:
द्वैगुणिकः A usurer who charges
cent per cent interest.

1 Dble amount, value,
[]
or measure.
--2 Duality.
--3 The
possession of two out of the three
qualities सत्त्व, रजस् and तमस्.

द्वैतं [द्विधा इतं द्वीतं तस्य भावः स्वार्थे
अण्]
1 Duality.
--2 Dualism in
philosophy, the assertion of two
distinct principles, such as the
maintenance of the doctrine that spirit
and matter, Brahman and the
universe, or the Individual and the
Supreme Soul, are different from
each other; cf. अद्वैत; किं शास्त्रं
श्रवणेन यस्य गलति द्वैतांधकारोत्करः

.
--3 N. of a forest.
--Comp.
--वनं
N. of a forest;

.
--वादः the
doctrine of dualism; see above.
--वादिन् m. a philosopher who
maintains the dvaita doctrine.

द्वैतिन् m. A philosopher who
maintains the dvaita doctrine.

द्वैतीयीक a. (की f.) Second;
द्वैतीयीकतया मितोऽयमगमत्तस्य प्रबंधे
महाकाव्ये चारुणि नैषधीयचरिते सर्गो
निसर्गोज्ज्वलः
; cf. तार्तीयीक.

द्वैध a. (धी f.) Twofold, double.
--धं
1 Duality, twofold nature or
state.
--2 Separation into two parts.
--3 Double resource, secondary
reserve.
--4 Diversity, difference,
conflict, contest, variance; श्रुतिद्वैधं तु
यत्र स्यात् तत्र धर्मावुभौ स्मृतौ

.
--6
Double-dealing, duplicity, one of
the six modes of foreign policy;
see द्वैधीभाव below and गुण.
--7
Contradiction.
--धं ind.
1 In two parts.
--2 In two ways, doubly.

द्वैधीकृ {c8c} U. To separate, divide
(into two).

द्वैधीकृत a.
1 Separated, made
twofold.
--2 Brought into a dilemma,
embarrassed, perplexed.
द्वैधीभू {c1c}

To become divided
into two parts, be disunited.
--2 To
vacillate, be divided or uncertain, be
in suspense (as mind);
कृत्ययोर्भिन्नदेशंत्वाद् द्वैधीभवति मे मनः Ś. 2. 17. s

1 Duality, double state
or nature.
--2 Separation into two,
difference, diversity.
--3 Doubt,
uncertainty, vacillation, suspense;
धृतद्वैधीभावकातरं मे मनः Ś. 1.
--4 A
dilemma.
--5 One of the six Guṇas
or modes of foreign policy.
(According to some authorities it means
[]
‘double-dealing’ or ‘duplicity’,
‘keeping apparently friendly
relations with the enemy’;
बलिनोर्द्विषतोर्मध्ये वाचात्मानं समर्पयन् । द्वैधीभावेन
तिष्ठेत्तु काकाक्षिवदलक्षितः ॥. According
to others it means ‘dividing one's
army and encountering a superior
enemy in detachments’, ‘harassing
the enemy by attacking them in
small bands’; द्वैधीभावः स्वबलस्य
द्विधाकरणं Mit. on
; cf. also

and 160).
--6 A contest,
dispute.
--7 Falsehood, duplicity.

1 Duplicity.
--2 Diversity,
difference.
--3 Falsehood.

द्वैप a. (पी f.) [द्वीपिनो विकारः --अञ्
द्वीपादागतः -अण् वा]
1 Relating to or
[]
living on an island.
--2 Belonging to
a tiger, made of or covered with a
tiger's skin.
--पः A car covered
with a tiger's skin.
--पं The skin of
a tiger.
द्वैपक्षं Two parties.

द्वैपायनः [द्वीपः अयनं जन्मभूमिर्यस्य
स द्वीपायनः, स्वार्थे-अण्] ‘The island-born’,
N. of Vyāsa.

द्वैप्य a. (प्या, प्यी f.) Living on
or relating to an island; Śi. 3. 76.

द्वैमातुर a. Having two mothers,
i. e. a natural mother and a
stepmother.
--रः
1 N. of Gaṇeśa.
--2 N.
of Jarāsaṃdha; हते हिडिंबरिपुणा राज्ञि
द्वैमातुरे युधि Śi. 2. 60.

द्वैमातृक a. (की f.) Nourished by
rain and rivers (as a country); cf.
देवमातृक.

1 A single combat in
chariots.
--2 A single combat in
general.
--थः An adversary.

द्वैराज्यं A dominion divided
between two kings.
द्वैवार्षिक a. (की f.) Biennial.

द्वैविध्यं^1
1 Duality, twofold
nature.
--2 Variance, diversity,
difference.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335.

द्वैसमिक a. (की f.) Two years
old.
द्वैहायनं The period of two years.
